captions.detailed: This is a classic architect's desk lamp made of dark-colored and metallic gray components. It features a heavy, flat cylindrical base, a vertical support rod, a dual-segment articulating arm connected by hinge joints, and a conical lampshade. The joints allow for multi-axis articulation: a swiveling base joint, a shoulder pitch joint, an elbow pitch joint, and a tilting shade joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an articulating architect's desk lamp. It must include a weighted circular base, a vertical support post, a lower arm segment, an upper arm segment, and a conical light shade. Implement revolute joints at the base swivel, shoulder, elbow, and shade tilt to allow full articulation.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by creating individual parts: a base (using Cylinder), a vertical post (using Cylinder), a lower arm link, an upper arm link, and a conical lamp shade. The arm links are modeled using Box and Cylinder primitives combined via boolean unions to form brackets and rods. The conical shade is constructed using a hollowed-out cone or lofted circles. It then defines four revolute articulations: a base swivel about the Z-axis, a shoulder joint about the Y-axis, an elbow joint about the Y-axis, and a shade-tilt joint about the Y-axis, with appropriate offsets and limits.
